details:
This module enables you to quickly toggle the publication status, promotion and stickiness of nodes, and the publication status of comments, from links on the page.

The module doesn't sufficiently check access to the entity being toggled, under the scenario where a user with the "Use Fasttoggle" permission submits a request to the toggle URL for any node or comment regardless of their permission to update that entity. For example, such a user could publish an unpublished draft they are not allowed to view.

This vulnerability is mitigated by the fact that an attacker must have a role with the permission "Use Fasttoggle".
